author: 欧洲民间故事
attribution: 据石头汤民间故事独立改写
intro: 口袋里只有一块石头，能给一村人做顿晚饭吗？

chapters.title: 广场上的晚饭
chapters.en: A [[hungry]] traveller stopped in the village [[square]]. A girl showed her an empty [[bowl]]. The traveller held up a [[stone]]. “Got a pan?”
chapters.zh: 一位饥肠辘辘的旅人在村子广场停下。女孩给她看了看空碗。旅人举起一块石头。“有锅吗？”

chapters.title: 石头能煮汤？
chapters.en: The traveller took the stone from her [[pocket]]. “Stone [[soup]]?” The girl filled a [[saucepan]] with water and set it over the [[fire]].
chapters.zh: 旅人从口袋里取出石头。“石头汤？”女孩往一把长柄小锅里灌了水，把锅架到火上。

chapters.title: 石头也要有伴
chapters.en: When the water began to [[boil]], a [[curious]] [[neighbour]] leaned out of her window. “What does a stone need?” “Company,” said the traveller. The girl cut up a [[carrot]].
chapters.zh: 水刚烧开，好奇的邻居就从窗户探出身子。“石头还需要什么？”“得有个伴儿。”旅人说。女孩切了一根胡萝卜。

chapters.title: 还差一点味道
chapters.en: The neighbour added an [[onion]]. The girl picked up a [[spoon]] and tried the soup. “Funny [[taste]].” The neighbour added a pinch of [[salt]].
chapters.zh: 邻居加进一个洋葱。女孩拿勺子尝了一口汤。“味道怪怪的。”邻居又撒了一撮盐。

chapters.title: 明天你带胡萝卜
chapters.en: “[[Delicious]]!” Under the last [[slice]] of carrot, the girl found an [[ordinary]] stone. She slipped it into her pocket. “Tomorrow, you bring the carrot.” The traveller laughed. “You know the [[recipe]]!”
chapters.zh: “真好吃！”最后一片胡萝卜下面，女孩摸到一块普普通通的石头。她把石头塞进口袋。“明天你带胡萝卜。”旅人笑了。“你已经知道做法啦！”

album.en: In the village [[square]], a [[hungry]] traveller asked for supper. A girl held up an empty [[bowl]]. The traveller pulled a [[stone]] from her [[pocket]]. “Got a pan?”
album.zh: 村子广场上，一位旅人饿了，想讨口晚饭。女孩举起一只空碗。旅人从口袋里掏出一块石头。“有锅吗？”

album.en: “[[Stone]] [[soup]]?” The girl filled a [[saucepan]] with water. They set it over the [[fire]]. A [[neighbour]] watched from her window as the water began to [[boil]].
album.zh: “石头汤？”女孩往一口长柄小锅里灌了水。两人把锅架到火上。水渐渐开了，一位邻居趴在窗口看。

album.en: “What does a [[stone]] need?” asked the [[curious]] [[neighbour]]. “Company,” said the traveller. The girl cut up a [[carrot]]. In it went. The [[neighbour]] passed her an [[onion]]. In that went, too.
album.zh: “石头还缺什么？”邻居好奇地问。“缺个伴儿。”旅人说。女孩切了根胡萝卜，下锅。邻居递来一个洋葱，也下了锅。

album.en: The traveller held out a [[spoon]]. The girl took a sip. “Funny [[taste]].” The [[neighbour]] added a pinch of [[salt]]. This time the girl licked the [[spoon]] clean.
album.zh: 旅人递过来一勺汤。女孩抿了一口。“味道怪怪的。”邻居撒了一小撮盐。这一回，女孩把勺子都舔干净了。

album.en: Soon everyone in the [[square]] had a [[bowl]]. “[[Delicious]]!” said the girl. Then her [[spoon]] hit something hard under the last [[slice]] of [[carrot]]. Clink!
album.zh: 不一会儿，广场上人手一碗汤。“真好喝！”女孩说。最后一片胡萝卜底下好像有什么硬东西。勺子一碰，叮！

album.en: “An [[ordinary]] [[stone]]!” The traveller held out her hand. The girl slipped the [[stone]] into her own [[pocket]]. “Tomorrow, you bring the [[carrot]].” The traveller laughed. “You've got the [[recipe]]!”
album.zh: “就一块普普通通的石头嘛！”旅人伸手来接。女孩却把它揣进了自己的口袋。“明天，你带胡萝卜。”旅人笑了。“这汤怎么做，你已经会啦！”
